title: Villa Saadiyat — Where the Light Lives
idea: Create a luxury cinematic commercial for a modern villa in Abu Dhabi
concept: The villa is presented through light, not features. Every shot follows the same low golden sun as it travels from the coast, across the façade and through the house, ending as the interior lights take over at dusk. The motif is a slow reveal from behind a natural layer: dune grass, palm fronds, a timber screen.
visual_direction: Calm, architectural, unhurried. One slow camera move per shot, corrected verticals, 24mm tilt-shift for exteriors and 35mm for interiors. Warm golden highlights over clean neutral midtones, with travertine, timber and bronze glass as the hero materials. No fast cuts and no lens flares beyond natural sun glints. People appear small and unposed.
logline: A day of light moves through a modern Abu Dhabi villa, from the dunes at golden hour to a quiet terrace at dusk.

characters.guest: a woman in her thirties in a loose ivory linen dress, barefoot, seen at a distance, never facing the camera

locations.villa: a two-storey contemporary villa of honed beige travertine and board-formed white concrete, with full-height bronze-tinted glazing, a cantilevered roof slab and a 25 m infinity pool facing the sea, on the Saadiyat Island coast

bible.grade: warm golden highlights, clean neutral midtones, cool sky gradient, gentle contrast
bible.palette: travertine beige, sand gold, bronze glass, deep sea teal, warm white interior light
bible.lens_package: 24mm tilt-shift lens, f/8, straight converging-free verticals
bible.lighting: golden hour sun low from the west raking across the façade, warm interior lights glowing, soft sky fill

sound.music: user-supplied ambient piano track, 70 BPM (CATANA does not generate music)
sound.sfx_style: soft wind over dunes, palm rustle, water lapping the pool edge, one low swell on the hero reveal
sound.vo_direction: unhurried, intimate, slight smile, with a pause after each sentence

shots.lens: 35mm lens, f/5.6, verticals corrected, natural interior perspective

shots.purpose: a human moment that sells the lifestyle
shots.subject: @guest walking along the pool edge of @villa, small in frame
